title: Initiative portfolio
intro: Initiatives are vehicles that close target-state gaps. A project portfolio is not a Target Operating Model. Proposed rank, selection and funding are three separate records: ranking never selects and selection never funds.
businessApprovalBody: this is a business decision recorded in the name of the person who makes it, with their rationale. The software never approves anything itself, and nobody can decide on someone else's behalf here.
conflictReloaded: Nothing was saved. The latest version has been loaded; review it and try again.

warning.initiative__deliverable_count: Key deliverables: the card should list 3 to 7.
warning.initiative__no_gap_link: No gap link: link a T03 gap or a diagnosed finding.

problem.initiative__g1_not_approved: Case for change not yet approved (G1): leadership agreement on problem, baseline and material value pools is required before an initiative enters the portfolio.
problem.initiative__outcome_before_activity: Outcome before activity: link at least one measurable outcome with a KPI before submitting for prioritization.
problem.initiative__direction_not_approved: North Star, outcomes and target state not yet approved.
problem.initiative__selected_unfunded: Selected - unfunded: a funding approval is required before launch.
problem.initiative__not_launchable: Only a funded initiative can be launched.
problem.initiative__not_ranked: The initiative is not in the current proposed ranking.
problem.initiative__not_withdrawable: Only a submitted or ranked initiative can be withdrawn.
problem.initiative__not_submittable: Only a draft initiative can be submitted.
problem.initiative__not_cancellable: A launched or completed initiative cannot be cancelled.
problem.initiative__not_deselectable: Only a selected or funded initiative that is not launched can be deselected.
problem.initiative__not_tom_evidence: A project portfolio is not a Target Operating Model: an initiative cannot be attached as G3 TOM evidence.
problem.initiative__read_only: A cancelled or completed initiative is read-only; its card and links can no longer be changed.
problem.initiative__gap_target_type: Link the initiative to a T03 gap or a diagnosed finding.
problem.initiative__gap_link_duplicate: This gap or finding is already linked to the initiative.
problem.initiative__decision_link_duplicate: This decision is already linked to the initiative.
problem.initiative__kpi_not_in_outcome: The KPI row does not belong to the chosen outcome.
problem.initiative__link_target_archived: The linked record is archived and cannot be linked.
problem.initiative__planned_range: The planned end date cannot be before the planned start date.
problem.selection__on_behalf_not_supported: A selection is decided by the approver in person; deciding on someone's behalf is not available. Nothing was recorded.
problem.approval__approver_is_proposer: Separation of duties: the person who proposed this cannot approve it.
problem.funding__not_selected: Funding can only be decided for a selected initiative.
problem.funding__not_revocable: Only the funding of a funded initiative that is not launched can be revoked.
problem.funding__amount_invalid: The amount must be zero or more, with at most 4 decimal places and 16 whole digits.
problem.funding__on_behalf_not_supported: A funding decision is decided by the approver in person; deciding on someone's behalf is not available.

list.title: Initiatives (T05)
list.intro: A draft can be created at any time, also before G1. Warnings are readiness hints, not blocks; they block only at G4.
list.emptyBody: Create a draft initiative to start the portfolio.

field.name: Name
field.financialBenefitHint: A narrative summary; the quantified lines live in the initiative business case.

rank.unavailable: The prioritization view is not available.

create.title: New draft initiative
create.note: The initiative is created as a draft with a generated code (INI-nn). Drafting is allowed at any time; submitting it to the portfolio needs G1.

hierarchy.title: Outcome hierarchy
hierarchy.intro: Read-only: North Star → outcome → KPI → target → initiative contribution.
hierarchy.noNorthStar: No current North Star is set.
hierarchy.noKpis: No KPI is linked to this outcome.
hierarchy.withoutKpi: Contributions to the outcome without a KPI:

card.draftNote: Draft - not submitted. It is not in the portfolio until it is submitted for prioritization.
card.readOnly: This initiative is {{status}}: its card and links are read-only.
card.warningsBody: They do not block saving; they block only at G4.
card.t05Intro: The fields of the source template, in its order. Fields 4, 7, 8, 11, 13 and 14 are linked records.
card.seeContributions: See the outcome and KPI contributions

submit.title: Submit {{code}} for prioritization
submit.description: The initiative enters the portfolio. G1 must be approved and at least one outcome contribution must name a KPI.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {{code}} to draft
withdraw.description: The initiative leaves the portfolio and returns to draft.

select.title: Select {{code}} for the portfolio
select.description: The approved portfolio selection. Selection does not fund the initiative: a separate funding approval is required before launch.

deselect.title: Deselect {{code}}
deselect.description: The initiative returns to the proposed ranking. Not possible once launched.

launch.title: Launch {{code}}
launch.description: Only a funded initiative can be launched. End-to-End: the North Star, outcomes and target state (G2 and G3) must be approved or waived.

cancel.title: Cancel {{code}}
cancel.description: Cancelling is final: the initiative and its links become read-only. Nothing is deleted.

gap.title: Problem / gap addressed: linked gaps and findings
gap.intro: An initiative is a vehicle linked to T03 gaps or diagnosed findings. It is never TOM evidence: a project portfolio is not a Target Operating Model.
gap.empty: No gap or finding is linked yet.
gap.addTitle: Link {{code}} to a gap or finding
gap.addDescription: Choose a T03 gap or a diagnosed finding that this initiative closes.
gap.otherTomGroup: Other TOM records (refused: not a vehicle link)

field.typeHint: Only a T03 gap or a diagnosed finding can be linked.

link.removeDescription: The link is removed with a reason and kept in the history; nothing is deleted.

contribution.title: Outcome/KPI contribution
contribution.intro: Each contribution names an outcome (required) and, optionally, a KPI of that outcome. Submitting for prioritization needs at least one contribution with a KPI.
contribution.addDescription: Outcome before activity: say which measurable outcome the initiative moves.

field.kpiHint: Choose the outcome first; only KPIs of that outcome are offered.

decisionLink.title: Required decisions
decisionLink.intro: Decisions come from the one decision log: their owner and due date are those of the decision.

deliverable.title: Key deliverables
deliverable.intro: The card should list 3 to 7 key deliverables. Acceptance is decided on the roadmap.
deliverable.notABlock: This is a warning, not a block.
deliverable.archiveBody: The deliverable is kept in the record but no longer counts as a key deliverable. Nothing is deleted.

milestone.title: Milestones
milestone.intro: Approved (baseline) dates and forecasts are shown separately. A baseline date is approved on the roadmap.
milestone.forecastHint: Moving the forecast never changes the approved date.

fundingDecision.title: Funding decisions
fundingDecision.intro: Each funding decision is recorded by a person with funding authority. Selection, ranking and funding are separate records.
fundingDecision.dialogBody: you record your own decision on this initiative's funding. The product records it; nothing is approved or funded automatically.
fundingDecision.inPerson: Decided in person: recording a decision on someone else's behalf is not available.
fundingDecision.outcomeHint: Approved moves a selected initiative to Funded; Revoked returns a funded initiative to 'Selected - unfunded'.
fundingDecision.amountHint: A decimal such as 1250000.50, typed with Latin digits and a dot. Leave empty when the amount is not known: it is then shown as Unknown, never 0.
fundingDecision.voidedBySelection: The earlier funding approval was recorded before the latest selection and no longer counts: the initiative is 'Selected - unfunded' until a new funding decision is recorded.
